public.spec: Implement a document-version resolver. payload has cutoff and records with UNIQUE string ids. Each set/delete record has id,key,kind,time,authority and sets additionally have value. Each retract record has id,kind='retract',target,time,authority; targets are set/delete ids, never retract ids. Records are not time-sorted. First exclude every record with time > cutoff. A remaining retract can revoke its exact target: scope='global' ignores relative times; scope='not_after_retractor' permits revoking only targets with target.time <= retract.time. If qualified_retractions=true the retract must also have at least the target's authority under the configured authority direction; otherwise its authority does not matter. Revocations are collected before winner selection, independent of list position. Group remaining set/delete candidates by key, lowercasing keys only when keys='lower'. Prefer larger authority if authority='higher', smaller if 'lower'. Prefer larger time. priority selects which of those two criteria is primary; the other is secondary. Exact ties use first or last INPUT position, or lexicographically LARGEST full string id when tie='id_lex' (not numeric comparison). A winning delete omits its key from values but DOES appear in sources. Return {'values':{key:value},'sources':{key:winner_id}}. Only keys with eligible winners appear in sources. Return fresh objects; do not mutate input. IMPORTANT: solve must not mutate payload, including any nested object; return fresh result objects.

public.spec: Implement an idempotent event ledger. payload contains initial balances (known account ids), initial frozen account ids, and events in execution order. All amounts and thresholds are nonnegative integers; all referenced accounts exist. cancel targets non-cancel event ids. When cancel='global', collect all cancel targets first and skip all occurrences of those ids, including earlier events. When cancel='forward', process cancel positions in order and block only later target occurrences; never undo earlier effects. cancel never enters accepted. For dedup='first_seen', mark each uncancelled unseen non-cancel id seen BEFORE testing its condition, even if rejected. For dedup='first_applied', mark only after execution: a rejected id can execute on a later occurrence with different payload. Always ignore already seen ids. credit adds amount, including to frozen accounts only if credit_frozen=true. debit executes only on an unfrozen account with enough funds. transfer requires enough source funds and unfrozen source; destination must also be unfrozen iff transfer_requires_unfrozen_destination. freeze/thaw set/clear frozen; a no-op counts as applied iff count_noop_freeze=true. bonus tests CURRENT balance of if_account against threshold using >= for ge or > for gt; if true it acts as credit to account with the same frozen rule. Rejected operations do nothing. A no-op freeze/thaw rejected for counting still leaves the same frozen state. Return {'balances':{account:int},'frozen':sorted_account_ids,'accepted':[executed event ids in execution order]}. Every applied event, including allowed no-ops, enters accepted once. IMPORTANT: solve must not mutate payload, including any nested object; return fresh result objects.

public.spec: Implement conditional configuration resolution. payload has defaults and layers, each with UNIQUE id, priority, requires (layer ids), when (null or condition), values (a patch). Normalize all default/patch/condition keys to lower case iff keys='lower'; otherwise keep case. Within a mapping process keys in their insertion order, including normalization collisions. Copy defaults as initial config, preserving null defaults. Sort layers by priority ascending or descending per priority_order; ties use original input order for tie='input' or lexicographically ASCENDING full id for tie='id_lex'. Requires means ALL listed ids must have actually applied, including ids absent from input which never apply. For single_pass, visit the sorted list once and permanently skip unmet dependencies. For revisit, defer only unmet-dependency layers; after a full pass retry deferred layers in the same sorted relative order. Stop when a pass applies no layers. Conditions are tested only when dependencies are satisfied: exists requires key membership (even null), eq requires membership and equality to equals. condition_context='snapshot' uses the normalized defaults; 'live' uses the current config. A false condition permanently rejects that layer and is NEVER retried. For each applied patch, if null='delete' and value is null remove that key regardless of merge; else overwrite when merge='overwrite', or only insert absent keys when merge='preserve'. Applied includes eligible true-condition layers even if their patches change nothing. Return {'config':final_mapping,'applied':[layer ids in actual application order],'blocked':[all unapplied ids in ORIGINAL input order]}. Cycles, missing dependencies and condition-rejected prerequisites stay unapplied. IMPORTANT: solve must not mutate payload, including any nested object; return fresh result objects.
